sections.label: Milk powder price rise
sections.summary: A question asks whether the Ministry will work with local distributors and retailers to ensure fair pricing of milk powder.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) given that the rise of milk powder prices in Singapore far exceeds inflation rates and the increment in other countries, whether the Ministry will work with local distributors and retailers to ensure fair pricing.

sections.label: Three measures on formula milk
sections.summary: Three steps are set out: more through maternity hospitals, reviewing import requirements, and stronger consumer protection through tighter advertising and labelling rules.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: First, we will do more through our maternity hospitals; secondly, to review import requirements to facilitate more formula milk options on our shelves; and thirdly, put in place stronger consumer protection by tightening advertising and labelling restrictions and regulations.

sections.label: Competition Commission formula milk study
sections.summary: The Competition Commission of Singapore recently completed a market study of the formula milk industry and competition at each supply chain level.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: The Competition Commission of Singapore (CCS) recently completed a market study which examined the formula milk industry in Singapore and the nature of competition at each level of the supply chain.

sections.label: AVA tightens formula labelling rules
sections.summary: AVA will tighten labelling and advertising rules, including prohibiting nutrition and health claims and idealised images for infant formula milk.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: The Agri-Food and Veterinary Authority (AVA) will tighten its regulations on labelling and advertising further, including prohibiting the use of nutrition and health claims and idealised images for infant formula milk.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: Taken together, the increased choices available and improved clarity of labelling should enhance the competitiveness of the infant formula market.

sections.label: Support measures and agency steps
sections.summary: Parents can tap Marriage and Parenthood Package measures, and MTI and other agencies will take steps on awareness, hospital practices, options and labelling.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: In addition to support for low-income families, all parents of Singaporean children can tap on the wide range of support measures under our Marriage and Parenthood Package, including the Baby Bonus Cash Gift, and Child Development Account to help defray child-raising costs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: The Ministry of Trade and Industry (MTI) and other Government agencies, such as MOH, HPB and AVA, will take steps to increase consumer awareness, encourage good practices in hospitals, facilitate more formula milk options and further tighten regulations on labelling and advertising.

sections.label: Educating consumers on formula adequacy
sections.summary: Consumers should be educated that all formulas meet minimum nutritional requirements and are equally adequate despite pricing strategies or claims.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: For the larger group of infants that require formula feeding, for which breastfeeding is not an option, then I think this is where we need to educate our consumers as well, that despite whatever pricing strategy that they have on the generic formula, or despite whatever claims there may be, all formulas actually fulfil the minimum nutritional requirements and are, in fact, just as equally adequate.

sections.label: Timing of changes for families
sections.summary: The speaker asks how quickly changes can be effected to help families, hoping some can be made by end of the year.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: So, I would like to know how quickly these changes can be effected to help families in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: And we hope that by end of the year, we would be able to make some of these changes.

sections.label: Monitoring cost of raising children
sections.summary: The Government will monitor the cost of raising children using data and evaluate whether specific price indices are needed.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: The Government will closely monitor the cost of raising children in Singapore using some of these data and evaluate whether there is a need to compile specific price indices for households in this segment.

sections.label: Import regulations and infant formula pricing
sections.summary: The speaker asks for assurance that the Government will work with producers, distributors and retailers to prevent price rises, citing a NAN price increase.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling
sentences.text: I hear the Senior Minister of State that the regulations, if any, in terms of changes to the imports and the regulations will take some time and will be towards the end of the year.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling
sentences.text: But I would like to ask if perhaps the Senior Minister of State can give an assurance that the Government will continue to work with the producers, distributors and even the retailers to ensure that the pricing will not continue to rise during this period of time.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling
sentences.text: Anecdotally, for example, which needs to be verified, residents have been telling me that over the last week, one of the brands, NAN, has increased its price by 7%.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: CCS is also keeping an eye and seeing how they can ensure that there is no price fixing, that there is also fair competition in the market.
